notes.title: Winter Sale, New Feature & Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39647153/6e36d27b0bbddf4fdfeeac4225869b2d72b01307.png[/img]

Good news to make your winter night exciting! Robin Hood: Sherwood Builders is joining the Winter Sale on Steam with a huge 50% discount! Now is a great time to play the legendary Robin Hood and fight for the freedom of Sherwood's people, if you have not yet taken on this mission.

This offer expires soon, so make sure you don’t miss out! 🏹

🛠️ New Feature
A new feature will soon be added to make the game even more interesting. 

A number of camps around Sherwood have grown sick of rats chewing on their pitch barrels, leaving the precious resource within to be wasted. So now you'll find them suspended above where the pesky rodents can't get to them quite as easily.
While to most this is a measure taken to prevent volatile goods from being damaged by pests, to the skilled outlaw it's an opportunity to wreak havoc with a flammable substance.
After all, no one's skilled enough to cut something down from a rope with an arrow... Aren't they...? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39647153/a0ac02beb4c88f50b365ae4ca53ef1463e980e94.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39647153/10342cc6ad63e95931632de49ad32038282db2cf.png[/img]

[b]🏆 Achievement Adjustments.[/b]
Based on your feedback we are pleased to announce a major change to “The Pro” Award. The Grand Archery Tournament minigame has been made simpler to complete changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39647153/49d788d547f418d94ce4bb35869755089da72787.png[/img]

The goal is now attainable for all players. The archery tournament will be more fun and challenging for everyone. We appreciate your suggestions and support – your feedback is greatly valued! 

[b]❄️ Summary.[/b]
Winter Sale is live! Also, check what’s new in the update.  Wilderness is waiting for you – get ready for more adventures and more challenges!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159420/Robin_Hood__Sherwood_Builders/

See you in Sherwood, Heroes!
~ The Robin Hood: Sherwood Builders Team

notes.title: Raven Update! 🏹
notes.content:
Dear residents of Sherwood! 🌳

[h3]We’ve got exciting news for you – today, November 25th, at 7:00 PM CET, we’re rolling out a new update alongside a special promotion: 50% off the game! 🎉[/h3]

[b]New Feature: "Avian Vision"[/b]
In this update, we’re introducing a brand-new mechanic that’s perfect for fans of tactical gameplay. Robin gains a unique ability called "Avian Vision," allowing him to observe the world through the eyes of birds in specific locations. 🐦

[b]How does it work?[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Tactical planning:[/b] Use the bird’s-eye view to watch enemy movements and carefully plan your actions.
[*] [b]Stealth redefined[/b]: Find the optimal paths and avoid danger with ease, taking your sneaking skills to a whole new level.
[/list]
This small yet incredibly useful addition adds a new dimension to your adventures in Sherwood!

Play for Less – 50% Off the Game!
To celebrate the release of the "Avian Vision" feature, we’re offering Robin Hood: Sherwood Builders at a special discount – 50% off for a limited time! 🔥

Don’t miss this opportunity to join the Sherwood community and experience life as the legendary archer.

[b]Ready to See Sherwood from a Bird's Perspective?[/b]

[h3]Play now[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159420/Robin_Hood__Sherwood_Builders/

A new point of view awaits – jump into the game and embrace the thrill of "Avian Vision"! 🕊️

See you in the forest, Archers! 🏹

notes.title: Arena Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39647153/8635830bd6b54e914e55e7d74ea788fdb7094e2e.png[/img]

[h2]The Arena Update![/h2]

[b]A brand new location[/b] is discovered deep within the wilderness surrounding Nottingham. A place of blood sports, where the stakes go really high, whether we're talking coin or lives... [b]Welcome to the Blood Cairn Arena![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39647153/8554f3b345549fe886655772af6d052998d9d658.png[/img]

[h3]Fighting Pit[/h3]
Gamblers travel here from far and wide, fighters of questionable character draw their weapons on its well-trodden ground, spectators cheer loudly, demanding their share of excitement. That's what the Blood Cairn Arena is all about. 
And now Robin can also join the fray in customizeable team fights, during which he either supports his fighters in the melee or from the parapet above, barraging the opponents with arrows and triggering traps.
It's a fight to the death for the ultimate prize!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39647153/c80aa7f54c680b774f6040140deda9d0fa17d1e4.png[/img]

[h3]A Familiar Face[/h3]
But what is the ultimate prize of Blood Cairn? Well, it's not just a high winning bet ever since the arena announced its Grand Tournament. It has drawn a bigger crowd than ever, coming after a phenomenal bounty of gold.
And who does Robin encounter among this crowd? None other than his distant relative, self-proclaimed rival, and master swordsman – [b]Will Scarlet[/b] (Don't call him 'Scarlock'). What kind of predicament is Will going to rope Robin into with this Grand Tournament in full swing?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39647153/33beb78ea43ec727c84b45ba361ee2de10dd0f94.png[/img]

[b]Visit the Blood Cairn Arena for the fight of your life today! Check Robin's house in the Village for hints on where to find it.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39647153/015c98b4639e08923ed2422b9d460178806e19cb.png[/img]

[h3]A Summary[/h3]
[b]Here's a list of all the features coming with the Blood Cairn Arena:[/b]
[list]
- Blood Cairn Arena location to discover and explore
- Betting feature in the arena as a source of coin income
- Arena fight feature for prizes with Direct and Assisted combat modes
- A quest storyline featuring Will Scarlet, a character from Robin Hood ballads
- Unique sword quest rewards
[/list]

May your arrows fly true,
MeanAstronauts Team

notes.title: A Sherwood Builders Daily Deal!
notes.content:
Sherwood Builders,

It is known far and wide that the hallmark of a great outlaw is to strike at the wicked Sheriff's forces when there is a great opportunity to do so. And speaking of great opportunities, have you heard the latest whispers among the forest thickets? [b]Robin Hood - Sherwood Builders is available at a [i]40% discount[/i] in a Daily Deal![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39647153/227a4dead67eb80a07148095d996d6d49ea0f8ad.png[/img]

If you haven't yet, seize this opportunity to: 
[list]
[*] Adventure across lands surrounding 12th-century Nottingham and explore their many hidden secrets,
[*] Construct your own hidden outlaw village deep in the Sherwood's forests,
[*] Take the fight to the kingdom's oppressive Sheriff by completing a broad range of quests as the legendary hero of English folklore,
[*] Develop Robin's character by improving his many skills and securing new equipment,
[*] Take from the rich, give to the poor, deliver justice to those who would prey on the weak – liberate tax gold and save people from the Sheriff's reign of terror.
[/list]

We've also taken the liberty of [b]releasing an update[/b] to the game for the occasion:
[list]
[*] Fixed errors in the Sandal Castle environment,
[*] Voiceover improvements for various characters,
[*] Enhanced combat by improving the queuing system and preventing overwhelming enemy rushes,
[*] Added TSR antialiasing to graphics settings,
[*] Fixed issues with stealth headshots not working properly,
[/list]
We appreciate the feedback we've been receiving from you and we continue our work to further improve the game and expand it, so stay tuned for more feature and content updates in the coming months! 

Keep your eyes on the prize!
MeanAstronauts Team

notes.title: Manufacture Update – Now available!
notes.content:
🏹[b]Greetings, Sherwood Builders![/b]⛺

The "Manufacture Update", our second content addition to the game is now available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39647153/7a482402cb5e8cd8d3d432ab8c1853df920c3690.png[/img]

[h3]Remember – the update allows you to continue your game with your previous saves![/h3]

With the Manufacture Update, we're expanding our building selection for Robin's Village. From now on, there are several new buildings belonging to the decorative and production categories. Now you can do even more to spruce up your hideout! One of these – not entirely a building per se – even comes with a little sweet surprise. 🍎 As for the two new production buildings, they are intended to make your efforts in obtaining certain resources a little easier if you're willing to invest a bit in their construction.

But apart from the above, we're introducing further fixes and adjustments to make your experience with the game more enjoyable – improved lighting and lip-sync animations for characters to make the game's world even more lifelike as well as further changes to combat for better play with, for example, fights that involve blocking and multiple participants.

Here's a comprehensive list of changes in the Manufacture Update, bringing the game to version 4.04.24.01:
[list]
[*] Added new Decorative category buildings to the Village Builder (with one rather helpful tree among them),
[*] Added new Production category buildings: the Butcher and the Garden for more convenient generation of certain resources and usable items,
[*] Added lip-sync animation to make the game's characters more lifelike,
[*] Improved icons for buildings in the Village Builder,
[*] Added toggle for point light shadows in graphics settings,
[*] Global adjustments to lighting in the overland and various locations,
[*] Added visual effect that indicates when Robin is hidden in tall grass,
[*] Rebalanced Robin's attacks and enemy abilities, as well as adjusted the mechanics of enemy shields for a better combat experience,
[*] Expanded system of enemy aggro to better work with group fights,
[*] Various AI adjustments and optimizations.
[*] Various enhancements to the game's sound effects, improving the overall audio experience,
[*] Fixed bug related to errors caused by weapon swapping,
[*] Various localization fixes.
[/list]

Let us know in the comments what you think about our changes. Stick with Robin's Merry Men to see what's to come!

Stay vigilant,
MeanAstronauts Team

notes.title: Core Update – Now available!
notes.content:
🏹[b]Good day to you, Sherwood Builders![/b]⛺

Our first major update, which we've dubbed the "Core Update", is now available! We've been carefully reading your reviews and listening to your feedback and, ever since the game's release, working hard to further improve your experience with it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39647153/c3e6430d1fd1ef5c2102255bc913ab20465aa988.png[/img]

[h3]Remember – the update allows you to continue your game with your previous saves![/h3]

With the Core Update, we primarily aim to provide Robin with more attacks from the start of the game, so that [b]its combat immediately becomes more dynamic[/b], rather than requiring, for example, progression in the Village Builder before the attack skills contributing to dynamic combat are unlocked. Incidentally, this required rebalancing for the skill upgrades.

Changes like these belong to several of the update's adjustments that intend to improve the overall quality of life and balancing of the game, [b]but that's not all. The Core Update also includes some new features[/b]: a special strong attack for Robin to overwhelm his foes, a friendly NPC to spar with, a new voice for Friar Tuck, and many more!

With this update, the game also becomes available with [b]Brazilian Portuguese localization[/b]!

Here's a comprehensive list of changes in the Core Update, bringing the game to version 4.03.26.01:
[list]
[*] Increased Robin's combat responsiveness by unlocking more active attack skills from the start of the game, adjusting their progression, and by enabling regular attacks in situations when no special attack is yet unlocked,
[*] Added a new strong attack for Robin that you can perform by holding down the normal attack input, which gives you an option from the start of the game to deliver a lot of damage at once, break the enemy's block, and potentially stun them. It is, however, slower and costs some extra Energy,
[*] Added new friendly NPC to Robin's Village, with whom you can practice combat,
[*] Added the item sort feature to containers,
[*] Added Brazilian Portuguese localization,
[*] Added the Sprint Mode setting to the start of the game, where you can choose to either toggle Robin's sprint or keep it active as long as the relevant input is pressed down. The Sprint Mode setting is still available in the Settings menu as previously.
[*] Added gamma setting to the game's graphics settings,
[*] Added the possibility to move the camera while placing buildings in the Village Builder,
[*] Added extra instructions related to combat in Robin's house,
[*] Added various adjustments for general audio improvement,
[*] Added indicators to compass markers that inform you whether a given object or character is above or below Robin,
[*] Added NPCs to Village buildings to liven the place up a little,
[*] Friar Tuck has a brand new voice!
[*] Rebalancing related to Repair Kit costs, attack skills, and some trader inventories (Wire has been added to hunter-type traders and Gypsum can now be bought from general-type traders and in Robin's Village),
[*] Rebalancing related to maximum item durability, where all items' max durability has been greatly increased (current durability of already created items will be retained, so they will have to be repaired if needed),
[*] Fixed bug related to the "Conquer Conisbrough Castle" quest, where it wouldn't be possible to progress the quest after leaving the convoy area. The convoy will now be available again when you return and you'll be able to finish the quest.
[*] Fixed bug related to the experience progression bar in Robin's character screen not being displayed,
[*] Fixed bug related to fog persisting after leaving the Nottingham area,
[*] Fixed bug related to custom map marker disappearing when zooming map,
[*] Various localization fixes,
[*] Various small bugfixes related to glitches in locations and quest progression.
[/list]

Let us know in the comments what you think about our changes. Anything else you'd really like to see in Sherwood Builders? We continue working on the game to further improve it, with big plans of new features, so do be here with us in the Outlaws' Village to see what's to come!

Good hunting,
MeanAstronauts Team

tags.balance_change: Rebalancing related to Repair Kit costs, attack skills, and some trader inventories (Wire has been added to hunter-type traders and Gypsum can now be bought from general-type traders and in Robin's Village),

Rebalancing related to maximum item durability, where all item's max durability has been greatly increased (current durability of already created items will be retained, so they will have to be repaired if needed),

tags.bug: Fixed bug related to the "Conquer Conisbrough Castle" quest, where it wouldn't be possible to progress the quest after leaving the convoy area. The convoy will now be available again when you return and you'll be able to finish the quest.
Fixed bug related to the experience progression bar in Robin's character screen not being displayed,
Fixed bug related to fog persisting after leaving the Nottingham area,
Fixed bug related to custom map marker disappearing when zooming map,
Various localization fixes,
Various small bugfixes related to glitches in locations and quest progression.

notes.title: Major Prologue Update
notes.content:
Here's fresh news for our brave defenders of Sherwood! Today, at 1:00 PM UTC / 8:00 AM EST, we're introducing a major prologue update to the game "Robin Hood - Sherwood Builders: Bandit's Trail". Check out the improvements which are also in store for you in the final version of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39647153/9d19caf14c55a5c636676f601be6881e671d33a7.png[/img]

Our team has taken your feedback to heart and improved many aspects of the gameplay. Now you can enjoy better game balancing, performance, and controller support! Here are the main changes:

[list]
[*] Game balancing improvements (weapon stats, loot, coin and experience gain, among others)
[*] Performance tweaks, including generic foliage and navmesh optimization
[*] Gamepad support added
[*] Several fixes improving the resource extraction system
[*] New enemy abilities
[*] Rebalancing for Robin's character development, different types of enemies and building costs
[*] Numerous AI improvements and fixes
[*] Stamina system improvements
[*] Stealth system improvements and dynamic character visibility scaling
[*] Player visibility gauge added
[*] Difficulty setting improvements (AI detection range is also affected by game difficulty)
[*] New enemy hairstyles and beards
[*] Status effect resistance system
[*] Enemy health bar now shows level and stealth kill possibility
[*] Visual prompts for enemy sight and hearing range added to Hunter Vision
[*] Combat system improvements (for example, parrying now adds a short invincibility window)
[*] Option of selecting time of day when resting
[*] Sort button for inventory
[*] NPC idle dialogues and monologues
[*] Redecorated character treehouses
[/list]
[h3]The scope of the updates means that [b][u]your current saved game files will not work with the newly updated version of the prologue[/u][/b]. Please take particular note of that fact.[/h3]

[b]But that's not all! [/b]At 2:00 PM UTC / 9:00 AM EST, we're also starting a livestream of gameplay from the updated prologue! Join us on the Bandit's Trail Steam page as we delve into the heart of the fight for justice!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2465830/Robin_Hood__Sherwood_Builders__Bandits_Trail/

[b]And there's still more![/b] We'd like to remind you that in just one week, we're embarking on a full adventure with the premiere of the full game version! Are you ready to become a legend of Sherwood?

[h3]LAUNCH ON FEBRUARY 29 2024[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159420/Robin_Hood__Sherwood_Builders/

notes.title: Skill tree
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Sherwood Builders![/h1]

During the game, Robin gains levels, thanks to which he can improve his passive skills like increasing the capacity limit or the critical damage dealt to enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39647153/6f774bb9ed60a5d56ccd81f08f6a210d816d1dae.png[/img]

After Robin gained enough experience he can unlock new traits, picking the one will unlock other in its close proximity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39647153/ded1742892653b16c25fbcd86f92dc8e8682fe6b.png[/img]

The skill tree is divided into four main categories: range, melee, health and crafting.
Some of them cost more than other, so plan ahead!

See you in the forest!

[url=https://discord.gg/ut6nS3kc][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39647153/fc521c8bf21bff775962df4f130bb74eb5577a46.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Tutorial Stream - how to become a real hero like Robin Hood!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Sherwood Builders! 🏹 [/h1]

[h2]We are pleased to announce that you will be able to play the demo of Robin Hood Sherwood Builders and watch the tutorial stream on the upcoming Steam Next Fest![/h2]

[h3]Join us on 07:00 PM CET, 01.10.2021 - here on Steam![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39647153/5cd8edcacff4d48828b97158335804c7f4df8620.jpg[/img]

Robin Hood Sherwood Builders playtests are over but we hope you will join us at the festival and we can play together again! This version of the game includes some of the suggestions that we received during the playtests and also fixed bugs!

It doesn't matter if you already know our game or maybe this is your first experience, everyone is welcome to participate! You can chat with us and ask questions, we will be more than happy to answer them.

When the stream ends you can simply start the game and let yourself be carried away by the adventure as a Robin Hood!

After you've played through the game feel free to share feelings, thoughts, and feedback for the game -
your opinion has a significant influence on how the game will look in the future, and it will help us improve many elements!

But wait, there's more! We have prepared a[b] contest[/b] for all of you and it starts at this very moment! Prizes include [b]free keys[/b] and [b]big discounts[/b] for the full version of the game upon its release! The contest will last until 31.10, so you have plenty of time to participate, and do not worry - each person has an equal chance to grab one of the prizes! You can find more information on our Discord channel, feel free to visit us!


And don't forget about our meeting on Steam 07:00 PM CET, 01.10.2021 😉

Robin Hood team 🏹


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39647153/fc521c8bf21bff775962df4f130bb74eb5577a46.png[/img]
